name: UpScriptHealth
shortInfo: UpScriptHealth is the only fully integrated telehealth provider that allows pharmaceutical companies to market Direct-to-Consumer.
brief: UpScriptHealth is a telemedicine platform connecting health-care providers with patients seeking treatment through virtual diagnosis and treatment programs, while adhering to strict industry compliance standards.
about:
The UpScriptHealth Connector lets you sync data from UpScript Data API to your data warehouse automatically.

Check more about UpScriptHealth Api doc [here.](https://dataapi.upscripthealth.org/docs)
availableData:
[Order](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/upscript-health/pipelines/order.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the details of all orders for a company from the UpScriptHealth platform.

[Patient](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/upscript-health/pipelines/patient.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the details of all patients for a company from the UpScriptHealth platform.

[Product](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/upscript-health/pipelines/product.html)
